systems.tiers: In 2023, 2,001 km of the country's 11,229.9 km of fibre were laid by the PBNT, interconnecting all regional capitals, 76% of provincial capitals and 36% of communes; no commune office is said to be on it

systems.country_label: Réseau informatique national de l'administration (intranet gouvernemental)
systems.tiers: Government intranet through which services hosted in the G-Cloud and datacentres are reached; the plan says much fibre is still needed to interconnect all public structures to it; 6.27% of health structures were on it in the 2023 survey; no local government office named
Government cloud hosting public services, reached over RESINA and the mobile internet; tiers not stated

note: Health ministry's digital health plan 2025-2029 (capture ends in the risk table; annexes absent). Its only statements touching communes are the PBNT backbone reaching 36% of communes in 2023 and the count of 351 communes; both are of the backbone class, with no commune office said to be connected, so no fact. The 36% is a network-passed share the parent may want under 'equipped'. A RESINA strategy for 2022-2026 is listed, with no mention of local governments.
